Poster Returns Policy

Returns

  • Time Frame: You have 14 days from delivery to request a return for posters.
  • Condition: Posters need to be in the pristine condition they were received in, including original packaging to prevent damage during return.
  • Process: Contact us with your order information and reason for return to begin the process.
  • Shipping Costs: You are responsible for the shipping costs of the return. These costs are non-refundable.
  • Refunds: Once we receive and inspect the poster, we’ll inform you of the refund decision. If approved, your refund will be issued to the original payment method.

Exchanges

  • Exchanges apply for defective or damaged posters only. Please get in touch with us for the exchange procedure using this form.

Original Art and Artprint Returns Policy

Returns

  • Time Frame: Returns must be requested within 14 days of receipt.
  • Condition: Art must be returned in its original condition and packaging. Please handle it with utmost care to avoid any damage. Art must be returned with a service that allows tracking of the item in transit. 
  • Process: To initiate a return, please contact our customer support team with your order details using this form and the reason for the return. We will provide you with the necessary instructions to proceed.
  • Insurance: You are responsible for insuring the return shipment. This insurance should cover the full value of the art, as you will be responsible for any damages incurred during transport.
  • Shipping Costs: The cost of return shipping, including insurance, is at your expense and is not refundable.
  • Damages: If the art is returned damaged and the damage occurred during return shipping due to insufficient packaging or lack of insurance, you will be responsible, and such items will not be eligible for a refund.
  • Refunds: Upon receipt and inspection of the art, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. Approved refunds will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment.

Exchanges

  • Please note, art items will not be exchanged. If you receive a defective or damaged piece, please contact us for a return and refund process.

About Us

The name ArtBlendArt itself is a playful reflection of our unique approach to art and its integration into everyday life. It encapsulates the essence of our mission: to blend the rich, expressive world of original art directly into practical, tangible experiences, creating a seamless fusion that elevates both.

In every syllable, ArtBlendArt tells the story of mixing and merging—where the first "Art" represents the pure, original creations, the "Blend" signifies the thoughtful process of transforming these artworks into meaningful products, and the final "Art" underscores the result—a collection of items that are as much art pieces as they are functional goods.

This name is not just our identity; it's a declaration of our commitment to blurring the lines between fine art and everyday living, ensuring that when you choose us, you're not just acquiring a product, but an artful experience woven into the very essence of your life.
Translated content:
Om oss

Namnet ArtBlendArt är i sig en lekfull återspegling av vår unika inställning till konst och dess integration i vardagen. Det sammanfattar kärnan i vårt uppdrag: att blanda den rika, uttrycksfulla världen av originalkonst direkt in i praktiska, påtagliga upplevelser, vilket skapar en sömlös fusion som förhöjer båda.

I varje stavelse berättar ArtBlendArt historien om att blanda och sammanföra – där den första "Art" representerar de rena, originella skapelserna, "Blend" betyder den genomtänkta processen att omvandla dessa konstverk till meningsfulla produkter, och den slutliga "Art" understryker resultatet – en samling föremål som är lika mycket konstverk som funktionella varor.

Detta namn är inte bara vår identitet; det är en förklaring av vårt engagemang för att sudda ut gränserna mellan konst och vardagsliv, vilket säkerställer att när du väljer oss, förvärvar du inte bara en produkt, utan en konstnärlig upplevelse vävd in i själva kärnan av ditt liv.

The shoulders have twill tape for improved durability. There are no side seams. The collar is made with ribbed knitting to prevent curling damage.

Key features

Without side seams

Knit in one piece using tubular knit, it reduces fabric waste and makes the garment more attractive

Ribbed knit with seam

Shoulder tape

Default content:
Jag heter Therese Parner och är konstnär, kreativ coach, tidigare lärare inom konst och kulturarbetare inom offentlig sektor, med magisterexamen i fri konst samt över ett decenniums erfarenhet som yrkesverksam konstnär. Genom åren har jag arbetat med många olika uttryck och material – från trä och textil till lera, metall och andra oväntade kombinationer. Mina olika roller har lärt mig att möta skapande på många sätt och jag kan guida dig både kreativt och konkret.

För mig är naturen och utomhus som ett magiskt rum där tid och fantasi möts. Här kan idéer ta form, tankarna rensas och skapandeprocessen får egna andetag. Det är en stund utan prestation, där sinnet får vandra fritt och oväntade uppslag kan spira – en källa till själslig energi.

I coachingen möts lekfull nyfikenhet och handfast guidning. Oavsett om du söker konstnärlig fördjupning, ny inspiration eller en trygg plats för skapandeprocessen, finns jag här som samtalspartner, handledare och påhejare i ditt kreativa utforskande.
Translated content:
My name is Therese Parner and I am an artist, creative coach, former art teacher and cultural worker in the public sector, with a master's degree in fine arts and over a decade of experience as a professional artist. Over the years, I have worked with many different expressions and materials – from wood and textile to clay, metal and other unexpected combinations. My various roles have taught me to approach creativity in many ways and I can guide you both creatively and practically.

For me, nature and the outdoors are like a magical space where time and imagination meet. Here, ideas can take shape, thoughts can be cleared, and the creative process can breathe on its own. It's a moment without pressure, where the mind can wander freely and unexpected ideas can sprout – a source of spiritual energy.

In the coaching, playful curiosity meets practical guidance. Whether you are seeking artistic deepening, new inspiration or a safe place for the creative process, I am here as a conversation partner, mentor and cheerleader in your creative exploration.

One-of-a-kind sculpture. Title "HairyKids, The Sibling"

Mixed media, cellular plastic, plaster, acrylic and faux fur.

The HairyKids sculptures are a series of enigmatic humanoid figures formed from the depths of imagination, these sculptures are reminiscent of the fleeting glimpses we catch from the corner of our eye, as our brain strives to make sense of what we've seen.

Standing at the size of a smaller dog, presenting a form that is familiar yet not quite like anything we have seen before.

With these sculptures I want to embody the mystery of the unknown. They also draw upon the rich traditions of mythology and folklore, reminding us of the enduring impact of these stories on our collective imagination.

Created by the visual artist Therese Parner, for more of her work visit www.thereseparner.se. For insight into the creation of the sculptures, visit https://www.youtube.com/@thereseparner5819

Please observe, one of the picture shows all hairy kids. The item for sale here is one of them, "The Sibling".

Approx 17" (43 cm) high, 10" (25 cm) wide

We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

To start a return, you can contact us at contact@artblendart.com.

Please note that returns will need to be sent to the following address: 

ArtBlendArt

Salamavalo AB
Ryttartorpsvägen 27
75471 Uppsala
Sweden

If your return is accepted, we’ll send you a return shipping label, as well as instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.

You can always contact us for any return question at contact@artblendart.com.


Damages and issues
Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged or if you receive the wrong item, so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.


Exceptions / non-returnable items
Certain types of items cannot be returned, like perishable goods (such as food, flowers, or plants), custom products (such as special orders or personalized items), and personal care goods (such as beauty products). We also do not accept returns for hazardous materials, flammable liquids, or gases. Please get in touch if you have questions or concerns about your specific item.

Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on sale items or gift cards.


Exchanges
The fastest way to ensure you get what you want is to return the item you have, and once the return is accepted, make a separate purchase for the new item.


European Union 14 day cooling off period
Notwithstanding the above, if the merchandise is being shipped into the European Union, you have the right to cancel or return your order within 14 days, for any reason and without a justification. As above, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.


Refunds
We will notify you once we’ve received and inspected your return, and let you know if the refund was approved or not. If approved, you’ll be automatically refunded on your original payment method within 10 business days. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process and post the refund too.
If more than 15 business days have passed since we’ve approved your return, please contact us at contact@artblendart.com.
